Totally, for real~!
! Trainer...

That alone won't be enough; we also have to
think carefully about what comes after rehab—

...No! I believe in the training routine you made for me,
Trainer. So I won't let myself rush into things anymore!
Whoa! W-What is that?!

(Their voice was shaking... yet they still said it with such conviction.
That I can win. That the way I am now, I can really win.)
Ayyy, let's gooo!
—Yes! I'm off!
(I want to give courage to so many people...!)
I'm looking forward to working with you, Trainer!
You were feeling down, so we all wanted to treat you to some food—
(—So one day, I want to take 1st place in a GⅠ,and give you a victory as a present.)

I made this so we could eat together.
I'm especially proud of the sweet-and-sour meatballs. Ehehe.

(It's okay, you can do it. Just like that, cheering them on.
I have to convey that through my running.)
Huh...?

(To my hardworking Trainer.
Thank you for always supporting me.)
Haaaaaaah!!
...! Traaaiineer!
(Just like back then—when Mother and Father smiled!)

...A voice that cracked like that carried zero conviction.
Even so, no matter how nervous I am, my trust in her will never waver.

(So, I will answer in kind.
I'll send courage to the Trainer who believed in me.)
Do your best, junior!

Yes, yes!
From now on, I'll... I'll try even, even harder...!

One of the girls I trained had the exact same injury.
I still have the data from back then, so I'll give you a copy later.
(To say thank you for drawing courage from me.)

Yes. It's actually a little past lunch already.
So, um... this is for you, Trainer.
Yes! Recovery comes first... I'll do my absolute best with rehab!
Let's make this a great start together!

Amidst the cheers, Nishino Flower smiles. It was a smile
reminiscent of the blooming flowers we once gazed upon together.

As I continued studying to give her my absolute best,
one day came around—a mock race was held at the academy.
...Deep breath in, deep breath out...

(Still, but still... because we worked so hard together, Trainer,
can I really run like I used to—...?)
(Back then, I couldn't keep up at all... It was so painful.)

Hehe, I'm so glad. If there's anything else you'd like to eat,
please let me know. I'll use it as inspiration next time♪

...Trainer, you're shaking.
Are you feeling nervous?
(Everyone is amazing...! But starting today, I will too!)

(My Trainer is such an earnest person.
A dedicated, hard worker who tends to push themselves too far.)
Side-by-side run, let's gooo! On a super short course, I'm blasting out the gate to the front~!!

...GOOOAL!
In 1st place is Nishino Flower! It's Nishino Flower!!
"The way you are right now, Flower, you can win...!"

Since she's in rehabilitation, we can't start full-scale training yet.
However, that doesn't mean there's nothing we can do. In fact—

And so training began, with Nishino Flower steadily
reclaiming her true form of running.

—And just like that, the days of rehabilitation flew by,
and the day to resume training finally arrived!

Mmh. The uphill course is next? Very well! I shall conquer
any hill and hurdle in my path! After all, I am the Class Rep!!

You want to make up for what you're lacking, huh... Alright, leave it to me! Gaining experience
is vital, but as a senior, it's also necessary for me to pass down what I know!

It's finally time, isn't it...!
I'm looking forward to working with you, Trai—
*Dummy text for SFX.*

Advice from seniors, library books, past records—
I design a rehabilitation routine drawing on every possible resource.
A m-mock race... Uu, I'm getting nervous...

Oh, <username>! Are you feeling better?
Thank goodness, we were all worried about you.
Trainer, have you eaten lunch yet?
Trainer!
